Reading The Board Difference = projection − total, in yards. Over and Under describe the model's position relative to the total, not a win probability. Values round to one decimal; a difference that rounds to zero shows “At Total.”

Season Over Rate The share of recorded games over the current total, including pushes in the sample and excluding byes and unconfirmed participation. This is historical context, not a forecast probability.

Only props with both a projection and a total are shown. DraftKings totals are an imported snapshot from Oct 16, 5:02 AM CT and may have changed. All kickoffs are in Central Time.

Projections are based on recent participation. Roster and injury status have not been verified.
